e.title: **一份**把**「**审稿意见**」**与**「**逐条**回应**」**整体**公开**的**沙特**车险**证据**包****：`saudi-motor-loss-ratio-review-package`——**⭐ 逐字自述**为**对**《**Digital Verification Capability, Motor Loss Ratios, and Insurer Performance: An Exploratory Panel Study of Saudi Arabia, 2020–2025**》**的**回应**信**；**⭐ 而**它**逐字**记下**审稿**人**的**一**句**关键**质疑**：**「**The underlying real data were not provided, while the Zenodo file is explicitly synthetic, making the 102 observations and estimates unverifiable.**」**；**⭐ 作者**逐字**回应 **「**Agreed.**」**，**并**逐字**重新**区分**两种**可**复现**（**计算**级** vs **来源**级）**；**⭐ 更**逐字**承认** **DVCI** 指标**算法**被**改**正**、**两**个**极端**值 **0.154／**0.985** 被**删除**、**四**个**假设**只剩**一个**成立****
e.summary: **Saudi Arabia motor loss ratio review package**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22741772`）**是一份**把**「**审稿意见**」**与**「**逐条**回应**」**整体**公开**的**沙特**车险**证据**包****——**逐字自述**为**对**《**Digital Verification Capability, Motor Loss Ratios, and Insurer Performance: An Exploratory Panel Study of Saudi Arabia, 2020–2025**》**的**回应**信**。**本次实测**：**⭐ 发布日 **2026-09-14****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`dataset`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****、**作者逐字 **`Mosa, Hamed A. H. Mosa`****、**文件**逐字**为 **`IMC_Zenodo_Complete_Evidence_Package_2026-09-14.zip`（**572,843 B）**；**⭐ 描述**字段**逐字**是**这**封**回应**信**全文**（**本次**实测 **10,919** 字符、**十三**条**逐条**回应）**。**⭐⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**」**。**⭐⭐⭐ 四处最值得看**：**① **它**把**审稿**质疑**与**作者**同意**一并**留**在**记录**里**——**⭐ 逐字**：**审稿**人**说**「**The underlying real data were not provided, while the Zenodo file is explicitly synthetic, making the 102 observations and estimates unverifiable.**」**，**作者**回**「**Agreed. The revised Data Availability Statement now states that the Zenodo file is synthetic and is not the empirical source dataset.**」**——**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**文件**是**合成**的」**与**「**数据**是**真实**的」**之间**若**不**写**清**，**读者**会**把**前**者**当**后**者**用**；**② **它**逐字**区分**两**种**可**复现****（**逐字**：**`computational reproducibility (re-running the calculations from the supplied workbook)` 与 **`source-level reproducibility (reconstructing each input from the original report)`**，**并**逐字**说**「**Only the former is currently possible.**」**）**——**⭐ 与**第 **378／379** 轮**记下的**复现**层**次**问题**同源**；**③ **它**逐字**承认**指标**算法**被**改**正**（**逐字 **`DVCI has been recalculated as (NA + DI + AU + API + DG)/5`**，**并**说明**五**项**二**元**等**权**时**只**允许 **0.00／0.20／0.40／0.60／0.80／1.00** 六**个**取值**，**旧**的 **0.154** 与 **0.985** 已**删除**）**——**⭐ 即**「**内部**不**一致」**被**一个**可**复算**的**算式**抓**到**；**④ **它**逐字**报**出**修**正**后**的**四**个**假设**结果**（**H1 **β = −0.023（**p = .458）**不**成立**、**H2 **β = −0.055（**p = .071）**仅**在 **10%** 边**缘**、**H3 **β = −0.571（**p = .001）**成立**、**H4** 间接**效应**置信**区间 **[−0.003, 0.064]** 含 **0** 不**成立）**——**⭐ 即**「**干净**结果」**被**换成**混合**结果**。**⚠️ 本次**未下载**其 **zip**、**未读**响应**内**的**全部**附件**。
e.body:
**Saudi Arabia motor loss ratio review package**（Zenodo `10.5281/zenodo.22741772`）**是一份**把**「**审稿意见**」**与**「**逐条**回应**」**整体**公开**的**沙特**车险**证据**包****——**逐字自述**为**对**《**Digital Verification Capability, Motor Loss Ratios, and Insurer Performance: An Exploratory Panel Study of Saudi Arabia, 2020–2025**》**的**回应**信**。**⭐ 本条目属于本轮主题**「**跨仓储元数据聚合面**」**。
**可核实信息（均 2026-09-20 Zenodo 记录接口实测）**：
**⭐⭐⭐ ① 它**把**审稿**质疑**与**作者**的**「**Agreed」**一并**留**在**记录**里****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**含**审稿**意见**「**The underlying real data were not provided, while the Zenodo file is explicitly synthetic, making the 102 observations and estimates unverifiable.**」**，**与**作者**回应**「**Agreed. The revised Data Availability Statement now states that the Zenodo file is synthetic and is not the empirical source dataset. It is described only as an illustrative code-and-format resource.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**对 **RIAA** 最有用**：**⭐ 即**「**我**给**你**的**是**合成**样本」**与**「**我**的**数据**是**真实**的」**若**不**在**同**一**句**里**说**清**，**读者**会**把**合成**文件**当**成**实证**来源**——**⭐ 而**这**正**是**第 **378** 轮**记下的**「**样本** vs **全量」**问题**的**姊妹**形态**（**那**一次**要**分清**「**样本**」**，**这**一次**要**分清**「**合成**」）**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**交**数据**作业**时**，**在 **README** 第一**段**写**「**本**文件**为**合成**／**真实」**，**成本**极低**、**收益**极**高**。
**⭐⭐ ② 它**逐字**区分**两**种**可**复现**，**并**说明**当前**只**能做**到**哪**一**种****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**the revised manuscript distinguishes computational reproducibility (re-running the calculations from the supplied workbook) from source-level reproducibility (reconstructing each input from the original report). Only the former is currently possible.**」**，**并**逐字**补充**「**The results are explicitly labelled exploratory and provisional until the source trail is completed and audited.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**能**重跑**我**的**计算」**与**「**能**从**原始**报告**重建**每**个**输入」**是**两**个**不**同**的**承诺**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**报告**可**复现**性**时**要**说明**是**哪**一**层**，**而**不**要**只**写**「**可**复现」**。
**⭐⭐ ③ 它**逐字**承认**指标**算法**被**改**正**，**并**给出**可**复算**的**算式**与**允许**取值**集合****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**DVCI has been recalculated as (NA + DI + AU + API + DG)/5 for all 102 rows. The maximum discrepancy between the stored and recomputed index is zero. Because the five items are binary and equally weighted, the only admissible values are 0.00, 0.20, 0.40, 0.60, 0.80, and 1.00. The previous minimum of 0.154 and maximum of 0.985 have been deleted.**」**；**⭐ 本词条认为**这一处**是**本条**最**技术**的**看点**：**⭐ 即**「**五**个**二**元**项**等**权**平均」**的**取值**集合**是**有限**的**六**个**点**，**而**旧**稿**报**出 **0.154** 与 **0.985** 便**自**证**与**所**述**算法**不**符**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**做**指数**或**评分**模型**时**，**把**「**允许**取值**集合」**写出**来**，**很**多**内部**不**一致**会**自己**暴露**。
**⭐⭐ ④ 它**逐字**报**出**修**正**后**的**四**个**假设**结果**，**把**「**干净」**换**成**混合****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**The revised H1 estimate is β = −0.023 (p = .458), so H1 is not supported. H2 is directionally negative but marginal only at 10% (β = −0.055, p = .071). H3 is supported: LR is negatively associated with ROA (β = −0.571, p = .001). The indirect-effect bootstrap interval [−0.003, 0.064] includes zero, so H4 is not supported.**」**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**这**份**回应**信**本身**不**是**数据**资源**，**它**的**价值**是**一**份**「**结**论**如何**随**证据**收缩」**的**实录**——**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**写**讨论**与**结论**时**，**用**「**associations」**取代**因果**语言**、**并**把**不**成立**的**假设**照**写**，**是**可**学**的**做法**。
**⭐⭐ ⑤ 样本**与**口径**的**修正**也**逐字**记下****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**描述**逐字**写**「**The sample is now correctly described as a balanced panel of 17 insurers over six years (102 observations), not an unbalanced panel. The LR models use 96 observations because the six Bupa Arabia rows contain no motor premium.**」**，**并**逐字**交代**变量**取舍**（**逐字**：**AGE is omitted because it is collinear with firm and year effects; SOLV is kept for robustness because of its correlation with LEV）**；**⭐ 本词条**据此**指出**：**⭐ 即**「**102** 观测」**与**「**96** 观测」**的**差异**有**明确**原因**（**六**行**没有**车险**保费）**，**这**种**交代**让**读者**不**必**猜**；**⭐ 对 RIAA**：**样本**量**变化**要**写**原因**，**而**不**只**写**最终 **N**。
**⭐⭐ ⑥ 元数据**、**许可**与**窗口****——**⭐ 本次实测**：**发布日 **2026-09-14****（**窗口内）**、**类型逐字 **`dataset`****、**许可逐字 **`cc-by-4.0`****、**作者逐字 **`Mosa, Hamed A. H. Mosa`****（**回应**信**落款**逐字 **`Hamed Abdallha Hamed Mosa`）**、**文件**逐字 **`IMC_Zenodo_Complete_Evidence_Package_2026-09-14.zip`（**572,843 B）**、**描述**字段**逐字**为**回应**信**全文**（**本次**实测 **10,919** 字符）**；**⭐ 本词条**如实**指出**：**⭐ 即**把**「**回应**审稿」**当**成**数据集**的**描述**字段**是**一**种**很**少见**的**用法**（**⭐ 读者**点**进去**看到**的**是**一**封**信**，**而**不**是**数据**说明）**，**故**其**元数据**可**读**性**与**数据**可**用**性**要**分**开**评价**；**⭐ 另**如实**记录**一处**同**作者**的**关联**工件**：**本轮**同**一**批次**还**命**中**了 **Harvard Dataverse** 的 **`10.7910/DVN/ESHFGC`（**《**Geopolitical risk, war-risk premiums, and supply-chain resilience: evidence from the Arab War Risks Insurance Syndicate**》**，**2026-09-16 发布**，**许可 **CC0 1.0）**——**⭐ 而**其**描述**逐字**声明**文件**访问**当前**受限**（**逐字**：**Access is currently restricted to authorized editorial and reviewer access during the technical verification stage.**）**，**故**本词条**不**把**它**立**条**，**只**记**下**这**一**处**「**受限**复现**包」**形态**留**待**下轮**。
**⭐⭐ ⑦ 与池内条目的关系**：**本站 [[insurance-qa-evidence]] 覆盖**线上**投保**流程**的**生产**环境 **QA** 证据**包**（**并**同**样**明**说**「**没有**把**合成**视频**当**真**实**交互**证据」）**、**[[motor-pricing-glm]] 覆盖**车险**定价 **GLM**、**[[reproducible-actuarial-work]] 覆盖**精算**可**复现**工作**——**⭐ 而**本条补上的是**「**把**审稿**往来**与**结论**收缩**过程**整体**公开**」这一**形态**；**⭐ 本词条**不对以上任何一条做代码级比较**。
**对 RIAA**：**⭐ 五件事值得借**：**① **合成**文件**与**真实**数据**要**在**第一**句**分**清**；**② **可**复现**要**说明**是**计算**级**还**是**来源**级**；**③ **把**允许**取值**集合**写出**来**能**抓**内部**不**一致**；**④ **不**成立**的**假设**照**写**，**并**用**关联**语言**取代**因果**语言**；**⑤ **样本**与**变量**取舍**要**写**原因**。
**⚠️ 本词条如实标注**：**① ⚠️⚠️⚠️ 本次**没有下载**其 **zip**（**572,843 B）**、**未读**回应**信**内**所**附**的**工作簿**与**任何**其它**附件**，**故**不**主张**其**数据**内容**、**变量**定义**或**结果**正确性**。**② ⚠️ 本次**只读**Zenodo 记录接口返回的**元数据与描述**（**描述**即**回应**信**全文）**，**未读**其**附件**。**③ ⚠️ **未核实**其**「**102 观测」**／**「**96 观测」**／**「**17 家**保险公司」**的**实际**数字**（**只**按**其**自述**记录）**。**④ ⚠️ **未核实**其**修正**后**的**系数**与 **p** 值**（**只**按**其**自述**记录）**。**⑤ ⚠️ **未核实**该**回应**信**对应**的**论文**是否**已**发表**或**被**接收**（**本次**只**见**回应**信**本身）**。**⑥ ⚠️ 本词条**如实**说明**：**呈现**这**份**记录**不**代表**对**作者**或**其**他**人**的**任何**评价**，**只**记**录**可**核对**的**文本**与**数字**。**⑦ ⚠️ 窗口**状况**：**发布日 **2026-09-14** 在**本轮**窗口**之内**（**基准日 **2026-09-20）**，**故**无需**缺口**说明**。**⑧ ⚠️ 本条目**所记为 **2026-09-20 所见**；**⚠️ 涉及**保险公司**绩效**与**车险**损失**率**，**⚠️ 不**构成**任何**投资**、**核保**或**定价**建议**。

e.title_en: An evidence package that publishes a peer-review exchange in full, consisting of a point-by-point response to reviewers of a study on digital verification capability, motor loss ratios, and insurer performance in Saudi Arabia: the record quotes the reviewer observation that the underlying real data were not provided while the archival file is explicitly synthetic, so the observations and estimates are unverifiable, and the author agrees, distinguishes computational from source-level reproducibility, recalculates the index construction, deletes previously reported extreme values, and reports that only one of four hypotheses remains supported.
e.title_hk: **一份**把**「**審稿意見**」**與**「**逐條回應**」**整體**公開**的**沙特**車險**證據**包****：`saudi-motor-loss-ratio-review-package`——**⭐ 逐字自述**為**對《**Digital Verification Capability, Motor Loss Ratios, and Insurer Performance: An Exploratory Panel Study of Saudi Arabia, 2020–2025**》**的回應信**；**⭐ 而它逐字記下審稿人的一句關鍵質疑**：**「**The underlying real data were not provided, while the Zenodo file is explicitly synthetic, making the 102 observations and estimates unverifiable.**」**；**⭐ 作者逐字回應「**Agreed.**」**，**並逐字重新區分兩種可復現**（**計算級 vs 來源級**）**；**⭐ 更逐字承認 DVCI 指標算法被改正、**兩個極端值 0.154／0.985 被刪除、**四個假設只剩一個成立****
e.summary_en: This is an evidence package that publishes a peer-review exchange in full, namely a point-by-point response to reviewers of a study on digital verification capability, motor loss ratios, and insurer performance in Saudi Arabia. **Measured this round**: published on the fourteenth of September inside the window, typed as a dataset, licensed for attribution use, credited to one author, and shipped as a single archive of about half a megabyte, with the description field being the response letter itself at roughly eleven thousand characters across thirteen numbered responses. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators.** **Four things are worth reading: it keeps both the reviewer challenge and the author agreement in the record, with the reviewer observing that the underlying real data were not provided while the archival file is explicitly synthetic so the observations and estimates are unverifiable, and the author agreeing that the revised statement now says the archival file is synthetic and not the empirical source dataset, which shows that unless the difference between a synthetic file and real data is stated, readers will use the former as if it were the latter; it distinguishes computational reproducibility, meaning rerunning calculations from a supplied workbook, from source-level reproducibility, meaning reconstructing each input from the original report, and states that only the former is currently possible; it records that the index construction was recalculated, so that five equally weighted binary items admit only six possible values, and that previously reported extremes were deleted, which shows an internal inconsistency caught by a recomputable formula; and it reports the corrected hypothesis outcomes, in which the first is unsupported, the second is only marginal, the third is supported, and the indirect effect interval includes zero, replacing clean results with mixed ones.** **No archive was downloaded and the attachments inside the response were not read this round.**

This is an evidence package that publishes a peer-review exchange in full, consisting of a point-by-point response to reviewers of a study on digital verification capability, motor loss ratios, and insurer performance in Saudi Arabia. **This entry belongs to the round theme of cross-repository metadata aggregators.**
**Verified information, all measured on 2026-09-20 from the record interface**:
**First, it keeps both the reviewer challenge and the author agreement in the record.** The reviewer observed that the underlying real data were not provided while the archival file is explicitly synthetic, making the stated observations and estimates unverifiable, and the author agreed, adding that the revised data availability statement now says the archival file is synthetic and is not the empirical source dataset and is described only as an illustrative code-and-format resource. **Unless a synthetic sample is distinguished from real data in the same sentence, readers will use the synthetic file as an evidential source, which is the sibling of the sample-versus-full-data problem recorded in the previous round: there the word sample had to be surfaced, here the word synthetic does.**
**Second, it distinguishes two kinds of reproducibility and says which is currently possible.** The response separates computational reproducibility, meaning rerunning the calculations from the supplied workbook, from source-level reproducibility, meaning reconstructing each input from the original report, and states that only the former is currently possible, adding that the results are explicitly labelled exploratory and provisional until the source trail is completed and audited. **Anyone reporting reproducibility should therefore name the layer rather than assert reproducibility in general.**
**Third, it records that the index construction was recalculated and supplies the formula together with the admissible value set.** The index is recomputed as the mean of five binary items across all rows, the maximum discrepancy between stored and recomputed values is stated to be zero, the only admissible values are six evenly spaced points, and previously reported minimum and maximum values are deleted. **Because five equally weighted binary items can only take six values, the earlier extremes were self-evidently inconsistent with the stated procedure, so writing down the admissible value set is a cheap way to expose internal inconsistency in an index or score of one own design.**
**Fourth, it reports the corrected hypothesis outcomes, replacing clean results with mixed ones.** The first hypothesis is unsupported at a coefficient near zero with a large p-value, the second is directionally negative but only marginal, the third is supported with a clearly negative association, and the indirect-effect bootstrap interval includes zero so the fourth is unsupported. **The package is therefore not a data resource but a record of how conclusions contract as evidence is examined, and writing up unsupported hypotheses while replacing causal language with association language is a practice worth imitating.**
**Fifth, the sample and specification corrections are recorded too.** The sample is restated as a balanced panel of insurers over six years, with a smaller number of observations used in the loss-ratio models because some rows contain no motor premium, and the response explains why one variable is omitted for collinearity and why another is retained for robustness. **Stating why an observation count changes is what saves a reader from guessing.**
**Sixth, metadata, licence, and window status.** Published on the fourteenth of September inside the window, typed as a dataset, licensed for attribution use, credited to one author whose signature differs slightly in transliteration from the record field, and shipped as an archive of about half a megabyte, with the description field being the full response letter of roughly eleven thousand characters. **Using a reviewer response as a dataset description is unusual, so a reader who clicks through meets a letter rather than documentation, and metadata readability should be judged separately from data usability. A related artefact by the same author was also found this round, a Harvard Dataverse replication package on geopolitical risk and war-risk premiums published on the sixteenth of September under a public-domain dedication, whose description states that access is currently restricted to editorial and reviewer access during technical verification, so it is recorded here as an instance of the restricted replication package rather than entered as an item.**
**Seventh, relative to existing entries**: pooled entries cover a production QA evidence package for online insurance purchase flows, which likewise states that synthetic video was not treated as real interaction evidence, motor pricing with generalised linear models, and reproducible actuarial work, **while this entry supplies the form of a peer-review exchange and a conclusion contraction published as a whole. This entry makes no code-level comparison against any of them.**
**For RIAA**: **five practices transfer: separate synthetic files from real data in the first sentence; say whether reproducibility is computational or source-level; publish the admissible value set of any index you design; report unsupported hypotheses and prefer association language; and explain every change in sample size and variable selection.**
**Marked honestly by this entry**: **first, no archive was downloaded and no attachment inside the response was read**, so no claim is made about its data content, variable definitions, or the correctness of its results. **Second, only metadata and description were read**, the description being the full response letter. **Third, the stated counts of observations and firms were not verified. Fourth, the corrected coefficients and p-values were not verified. Fifth, whether the manuscript corresponding to this response has been published or accepted was not verified. Sixth, presenting this record constitutes no judgement about the author or anyone else**, only a record of checkable text and numbers. **Seventh, the publication date falls inside this round window against a baseline of the twentieth of September. Eighth, this entry records what was visible on that date and states plainly that it constitutes no investment, underwriting, or pricing advice.**
